proof_sketch: The missing __syncthreads() inside the max reduction loop creates a potential cross-warp race. However, the softmax output is normalized (sums to 1.0), which masks most incorrect max computations. If wrong_max < true_max, all exp(x[i] - wrong_max) values scale by the same factor exp(true_max - wrong_max), and the normalization by sum cancels this factor. The output only changes when the wrong_max causes overflow/underflow before normalization, or when specific value distributions make relative differences exceed tolerance.
